newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Bass downgraded by Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bass downgraded by Lehman.

text.p: Bass Plc was downgraded by Lehman Brothers to "neutral" from "outperform," market sources said on Wednesday.

The brokerage had changed its stance on the British brewer, saying it didn't believe the recent acquisition of the Carlsberg-Tetley joint venture would enhance Bass' long-term or short-term earnings growth, they said.
Shares in Bass were up 3-1/2p at 840p at 1044 GMT.
